entries.title: Isaiah 62:1
segments: ¶For Zion's sake will I not hold my peace, and for Jerusalem's sake I will not be still, until her righteousness go forth as brightness, and her salvation as a torch that burneth.

entries.title: Isaiah 62:2
segments: And the nations shall see thy righteousness, and all kings thy glory; and thou shalt be called by a new name, which the mouth of Jehovah will name.

entries.title: Isaiah 62:3
segments: And thou shalt be a crown of beauty in the hand of Jehovah, and a royal diadem in the hand of thy God.

entries.title: Isaiah 62:4
segments: Thou shalt no more be termed, Forsaken; neither shall thy land any more be termed, Desolate: but thou shalt be called, My delight is in her, and thy land, Married; for Jehovah delighteth in thee, and thy land shall be married.

entries.title: Isaiah 62:5
segments: For [as] a young man marrieth a virgin, shall thy sons marry thee; and with the joy of the bridegroom over the bride, shall thy God rejoice over thee.

entries.title: Isaiah 62:6
segments: ¶I have set watchmen upon thy walls, Jerusalem; all the day and all the night they shall never hold their peace: ye that put Jehovah in remembrance, keep not silence,

entries.title: Isaiah 62:7
segments: and give him no rest, till he establish, and till he make Jerusalem a praise in the earth.

entries.title: Isaiah 62:8
segments: Jehovah hath sworn by his right hand and by the arm of his strength, I will indeed no more give thy corn [to be] food for thine enemies; and the sons of the alien shall not drink thy new wine, for which thou hast laboured;

entries.title: Isaiah 62:9
segments: for they that have garnered it shall eat it, and praise Jehovah; and they that have gathered it shall drink it in the courts of my holiness.

entries.title: Isaiah 62:10
segments: ¶Go through, go through the gates; prepare the way of the people; cast up, cast up the highway; gather out the stones; lift up a banner for the peoples.

entries.title: Isaiah 62:11
segments: Behold, Jehovah hath proclaimed unto the end of the earth, Say ye to the daughter of Zion, Behold, thy salvation cometh; behold, his reward is with him, and his recompence before him.

entries.title: Isaiah 62:12
segments: And they shall call them, The holy people, The redeemed of Jehovah; and thou shalt be called, The sought out, The city not forsaken.
